SCTP::release
Description
Causes SCTP to resume processing the connection and flush collected
data.
Syntax
SCTP
::
release
SCTP::release
Causes SCTP to resume processing the connection and flush collected
data.
Examples
when
CLIENT_ACCEPTED
{
SCTP
::
collect
15
}
when
CLIENT_DATA
{
if
{
[
SCTP
::
payload
15
]
contains
"XYZ"
}
{
pool
xyz_servers
}
else
{
pool
web_servers
}
SCTP
::
release
}
